summary.lv: WeAreDots SIA, Latvijas IT uzņēmums un Microsoft zelta partneris, meklē datorsistēmu administratoru/-i, kurš/-a pārvaldīs un uzturēs organizācijas IT infrastruktūru, serverus, tīklus un mākoņrisinājumus (Azure, Office365).
summary.en: WeAreDots SIA, a Latvian IT company and Microsoft gold partner, is hiring a System Administrator to manage and maintain IT infrastructure including servers, networks, and cloud solutions (Azure, Office365, Intune), with hands-on Linux/Windows and virtualization experience.
